METAVERSAL ARTS

Privacy

Last updated: 2 November 2026.

A small digital footprint

This website uses no analytics, advertising pixels, application cookies, browser storage, or embedded social-media players. Artwork and fonts are served locally or use your system fonts. Opening an artwork preview does not send information to a separate service.

Email signup

The email signup is a design preview and is not active. Its email field and button are disabled. No email addresses are collected, stored, or submitted through it. This notice will be updated before signup is activated.

Website hosting

The published website is intended to use GitHub Pages, operated by GitHub, Inc., USA. When you access the hosted website, GitHub receives technical request data, including your IP address and browser/request information, to deliver the page and maintain security. The operator’s basis for necessary delivery and security processing is legitimate interests under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. Metaversalarts maintains no separate visitor log or analytics database.

GitHub determines retention of its hosting data and may process it outside the EEA. Its retention criteria, transfer safeguards and data-protection contacts are described in the GitHub General Privacy Statement.

External links

YouTube, X, and other external websites are contacted when you follow their links. Their respective privacy policies then apply. Social-media content is not embedded on this page.

Contact enquiries

If you contact the studio by email or telephone, the information you provide is used to respond to your enquiry. Contract-related enquiries are handled under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR; other correspondence is handled under Article 6(1)(f), based on the legitimate interest in responding. Correspondence is retained while needed to resolve the enquiry and meet applicable legal retention obligations. Selecting an email link opens your own email application.

Controller and your rights

The controller is Roger Bootsma, Metaversalarts. Contact details and the business address are provided in the Impressum. Where applicable, you can request access, correction, erasure, restriction or portability of your data and object to processing based on legitimate interests. You may lodge a complaint with the Austrian Data Protection Authority.
